endorsements.quote: Statement 10. Patient should be informed when AI-assisted colonoscopy is used in CRC screening.
Statement 9. Knowledge and use of AI-assisted colonoscopy should be included in the training of colonoscopy.
Statement 4. CADx can be used for characterization of polyps but is not yet ready to determine the necessity of polypectomy.
These ethical and professional concerns should be understood by the users of AI-assisted colonoscopy.

unlisted_practices: Evaluate use of computer-assisted detection where it is available and cost-effective as an adjunct to conventional colonoscopy for CRC screening.
Report adenomas per colonoscopy in addition to adenoma detection rate when evaluating computer-assisted detection.
Use computer-assisted quality assurance for real-time monitoring of colonoscopy quality.
Consider computer-assisted quality assurance reporting, when available, to standardize colonoscopy reporting quality.
Engage endoscopists and endoscopy assistants, including nurses, in AI implementation to gain trust and facilitate adoption.
Conduct region-specific health economic analyses and consider healthcare equity when recommending AI-assisted colonoscopy.
Conduct further validation studies, including longer follow-up on CRC incidence and mortality, for AI-assisted colonoscopy.

screen.reason: This is an expert consensus statement developed via a modified Delphi process providing clinical guidance and recommendations on implementing AI-assisted colonoscopy.
